john.8.p1.b1.text: But Jesus went to the Mount of Olives.

john.8.p1.b2.text: Early in the morning He went back into the temple courts. All the people came to Him, and He sat down to teach them.

john.8.p1.b3.text: The scribes and Pharisees, however, brought to Him a woman caught in adultery. They made her stand before them

john.8.p2.b1.text: “Teacher, this woman was caught in the act of adultery. In the Law Moses commanded us to stone such a woman.

john.8.p2.b3.text: They said this to test Him, in order to have a basis for accusing Him.

john.8.p2.b4.text: But Jesus bent down and began to write on the ground with His finger.

john.8.p3.b1.text: When they continued to question Him,

john.8.p3.b2.text: “Let him who is without sin among you be the first to cast a stone at her.”

john.8.p3.b3.text: And again He bent down and wrote on the ground.

john.8.p4.b1.text: When they heard this, they began to go away one by one, beginning with the older ones,

john.8.p4.b2.text: until only Jesus was left, with the woman standing there.

john.8.p5.b1.text: “Woman, where are your accusers? Has no one condemned you?”

john.8.p6.b1.text: Once again, Jesus spoke to the people and said,

john.8.p6.b2.text: “I am the light of the world.

john.8.p6.b3.text: Whoever follows Me will never walk in the darkness, but will have the light of life.”

john.8.p7.b1.text: “You are testifying about Yourself; Your testimony is not valid.”

john.8.p7.b2.text: “Even if I testify about Myself, My testimony is valid, because I know where I came from and where I am going.

john.8.p7.b3.text: … because I am not alone; I am with the Father who sent Me.

john.8.p8.b2.text: “You do not know Me or My Father,” … “If you knew Me, you would know My Father as well.”

john.8.p8.b3.text: He spoke these words while teaching in the temple courts, near the treasury. Yet no one seized Him, because His hour had not yet come.

john.8.p9.b1.text: “I am going away, and you will look for Me, but you will die in your sin. Where I am going, you cannot come.”

john.8.p9.b2.text: “Will He kill Himself, since He says, ‘Where I am going, you cannot come’?”

john.8.p9.b3.text: “You are from below; I am from above. You are of this world; I am not of this world.

john.8.p10.b2.text: “When you have lifted up the Son of Man, then you will know that I am He, and that I do nothing on My own,

john.8.p10.b3.text: As Jesus spoke these things, many believed in Him.

john.8.p11.b1.text: “If you continue in My word, you are truly My disciples. Then you will know the truth, and the truth will set you free.”

john.8.p11.b2.text: “We are Abraham’s descendants,” … “We have never been slaves to anyone. How can You say we will be set free?”

john.8.p11.b3.text: “Truly, truly, I tell you, everyone who sins is a slave to sin.

john.8.p11.b4.text: A slave is not a permanent member of the family, but a son belongs to it forever. So if the Son sets you free, you will be free indeed.

john.8.p12.b1.text: I know you are Abraham’s descendants, but you are trying to kill Me because My word has no place within you.

john.8.p12.b3.text: “We are not illegitimate children,” … “Our only Father is God Himself.”

john.8.p13.b1.text: “If God were your Father, you would love Me, for I have come here from God.

john.8.p13.b2.text: Why do you not understand what I am saying?

john.8.p13.b3.text: You belong to your father, the devil, and you want to carry out his desires.

john.8.p13.b4.text: Which of you can prove Me guilty of sin?

john.8.p14.b1.text: “Are we not right to say that You are a Samaritan and You have a demon?”

john.8.p14.b2.text: “I do not have a demon,” … “but I honor My Father, and you dishonor Me.

john.8.p14.b3.text: Truly, truly, I tell you, if anyone keeps My word, he will never see death.”

john.8.p15.b1.text: “Now we know that You have a demon!” … “Abraham died, and so did the prophets,

john.8.p15.b2.text: Are You greater than our father Abraham? … Who do You claim to be?”

john.8.p15.b3.text: The One who glorifies Me is My Father, of whom you say ‘He is our God.’

john.8.p15.b4.text: You do not know Him, but I know Him.

john.8.p16.b1.text: Your father Abraham rejoiced that he would see My day. He saw it and was glad.”

john.8.p16.b2.text: “You are not yet fifty years old, and You have seen Abraham?”

john.8.p16.b3.text: “Truly, truly, I tell you,” … “before Abraham was born, I am!”

john.8.p17.b1.text: At this, they picked up stones to throw at Him.

john.8.p17.b2.text: But Jesus was hidden and went out of the temple area.
